item.title: Music Generator 0.2.0
item.description:
Changes since daily-207

  • Give Studio one purpose-specific audio file button (#171) · #167 Audio-Dateiauswahl im Studio auf einen eindeutigen Upload-Button zusammenführen
  • Allow more time for the full-library reference request (#163)
  • Add remix, queue, and expanded stem mixing workflows (#162)
  • Add MCP multimodel stem mixing workflows (#161)
  • Fix stem resampling frame count rounding (#160)
  • Reuse native engine components across Linux CUDA builds (#159)
  • Release Web Audio resources and report decode failures (#153)
  • Restore Windows window placement on the destination monitor (#89) (#152) · #89 Windows: Gespeicherten normalen Fensterzustand beim Start wiederherstellen
  • Add local stem separation and mixer workflows (#158)
  • Document verified ACE-Step seed reproducibility (#154)
  • Fix Develop packaging on macOS and Windows (#157)
  • Download generation engines separately (#156)
  • Add a localized macOS app menu (#150)
  • Prefer the LAN IPv4 address for phone pairing (#151)
  • Use verified HTTPS for phone and MCP LAN access (#104) (#119) · #104 Zugriffsschlüssel für nativen Handy-Zugriff und MCP im LAN verschlüsselt übertragen
  • Add studio themes and improve generation and audio export (#149)
  • Integrate music providers and improve model management (#148)
  • Add notarized macOS Stable auto-updates (#147)
  • Retain the two newest daily desktop releases (#146)

Full change history
